Review target: `theres a lot of bugs`

`high effort → 3+5 angles × 6 candidates → 1-vote verify (recall-biased) → ≤10 findings`

You are reviewing for **recall** at high effort: catch every real bug a careful
reviewer would catch in one sitting. At this level, catching real bugs matters
more than avoiding false positives. Err on the side of surfacing.

## Phase 0 — Gather the diff

Run `git diff @{upstream}...HEAD` (or `git diff main...HEAD` / `git diff HEAD~1`
if there's no upstream) to get the unified diff under review. If there are
uncommitted changes, or the range diff is empty, also run `git diff HEAD` and
include the working-tree changes in scope — the review often runs before the
commit. If a PR number, branch name, or file path was passed as an argument,
review that target instead. Treat this diff as the review scope.

## Phase 1 — Find candidates (3 correctness angles + 3 cleanup angles + 1 altitude angle + 1 conventions angle, up to 6 each)

Run **8 independent finder angles** via the Agent tool. Each
surfaces **up to 6 candidate findings** with `file`, `line`, a one-line
`summary`, and a concrete `failure_scenario`. If the Agent tool is not available in your current tool set, do not error — perform each angle (and each verification) yourself, sequentially, in this context.

### Angle A — line-by-line diff scan

Read every hunk in the diff, line by line. Then Read the enclosing function for
each hunk — bugs in unchanged lines of a touched function are in scope (the PR
re-exposes or fails to fix them). For every line ask: what input, state, timing,
or platform makes this line wrong? Look for inverted/wrong conditions,
off-by-one, null/undefined deref, missing `await`, falsy-zero checks,
wrong-variable copy-paste, error swallowed in catch, unescaped regex metachars.

### Angle B — removed-behavior auditor

For every line the diff DELETES or replaces, name the invariant or behavior it
enforced, then search the new code for where that invariant is re-established.
If you can't find it, that's a candidate: a removed guard, a dropped error
path, a narrowed validation, a deleted test that was covering a real case.

### Angle C — cross-file tracer

For each function the diff changes, find its callers (Grep for the symbol) and
check whether the change breaks any call site: a new precondition, a changed
return shape, a new exception, a timing/ordering dependency. Also check callees:
does a parallel change in the same PR make a call unsafe?

### Reuse

The angles above hunt for bugs; this one and the next two hunt for cleanup in
the changed code. Flag new code that re-implements something the codebase
already has — Grep shared/utility modules and files adjacent to the change,
and name the existing helper to call instead.

### Simplification

Flag unnecessary complexity the diff adds: redundant or derivable state,
copy-paste with slight variation, deep nesting, dead code left behind. Name
the simpler form that does the same job.

### Efficiency

Flag wasted work the diff introduces: redundant computation or repeated I/O,
independent operations run sequentially, blocking work added to startup or
hot paths. Also flag long-lived objects built from closures or captured
environments — they keep the entire enclosing scope alive for the object's
lifetime (a memory leak when that scope holds large values); prefer a
class/struct that copies only the fields it needs. Name the cheaper
alternative.

### Altitude

Check that each change is implemented at the right depth, not as a fragile
bandaid. Special cases layered on shared infrastructure are a sign the fix
isn't deep enough — prefer generalizing the underlying mechanism over adding
special cases.

### Conventions (CLAUDE.md)

Find the CLAUDE.md files that govern the changed code: the user-level
~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, the repo-root CLAUDE.md, plus any CLAUDE.md or
CLAUDE.local.md in a directory that is an ancestor of a changed file (a
directory's CLAUDE.md only applies to files at or below it). Read each one
that exists, then check the diff for clear violations of the rules they state.

Only flag a violation when you can quote the exact rule and the exact line
that breaks it — no style preferences, no vague "spirit of the doc"
inferences. In the finding, name the CLAUDE.md path and quote the rule so the
report can cite it. If no CLAUDE.md applies, return nothing for this angle.

Cleanup, altitude, and conventions candidates use the same
`file`/`line`/`summary` shape; in `failure_scenario`, state the concrete
cost (what is duplicated, wasted, harder to maintain, or which CLAUDE.md rule
is broken) instead of a crash. Correctness bugs always outrank cleanup,
altitude, and conventions findings when the output cap forces a cut.

Pass every candidate with a nameable failure scenario through — finders that
silently drop half-believed candidates bypass the verify step and are the
dominant cause of misses.

## Phase 2 — Verify (1-vote, recall-biased)

Dedup near-duplicates (same defect, same location, same reason → keep one). For
each remaining candidate, run **one verifier** via the Agent tool:
give it the diff, the relevant file(s), and the candidate; it returns exactly
one of **CONFIRMED / PLAUSIBLE / REFUTED**.

**PLAUSIBLE by default** — do not refute a candidate for being "speculative" or
"depends on runtime state" when the state is realistic: concurrency races,
nil/undefined on a rare-but-reachable path (error handler, cold cache, missing
optional field), falsy-zero treated as missing, off-by-one on a boundary the
code does not exclude, retry storms / partial failures, regex/allowlist that
lost an anchor. These are PLAUSIBLE.

**REFUTED** only when constructible from the code: factually wrong (quote the
actual line); provably impossible (type/constant/invariant — show it); already
handled in this diff (cite the guard); or pure style with no observable effect.

Keep **CONFIRMED and PLAUSIBLE**. Drop REFUTED.

## Output

Return findings as a JSON array of at most 10 objects:

```json
[
  {
    "file": "path/to/file.ext",
    "line": 123,
    "summary": "one-sentence statement of the bug",
    "failure_scenario": "concrete inputs/state → wrong output/crash"
  }
]
```

Ranked most-severe first. If more than 10 survive, keep the 10 most
severe. If nothing survives verification, return `[]`. Do not call the
ReportFindings tool even if it is available - this review's
output contract is the JSON block above.

63	Public Sub FinalizeSheet(ws As Worksheet, verifyOptions As Collection, workedOptions As Collection, uniqueEmp As Collection)
64	    LastAction = "FinalizeSheet(" & ws.Name & "): computing last row"
65	    Dim lastRow As Long
66	    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
67	
68	    ' One bucket per Mon-Sun week touched by this sheet's own Date column. A monthly
69	    ' report's dates are always contiguous (day 1 through the last day of the month,
70	    ' per ParseDayHeaders), so this always produces 5 or 6 buckets, never a gap.
71	    Dim weekStarts(1 To 10) As Date, weekEnds(1 To 10) As Date, weekCount As Long
72	    Dim firstDate As Date, lastDate As Date, wStart As Date, wi As Long, wCol As Long, weekHdr As String
73	    weekCount = 0
74	    If lastRow >= 2 Then
75	        firstDate = Application.WorksheetFunction.Min(ws.Range("D2:D" & lastRow))
76	        lastDate = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(ws.Range("D2:D" & lastRow))
77	
78	        wStart = firstDate - (Weekday(firstDate, vbMonday) - 1)
79	        Do While wStart <= lastDate
80	            weekCount = weekCount + 1
81	            weekStarts(weekCount) = wStart
82	            weekEnds(weekCount) = wStart + 6
83	            wStart = wStart + 7
84	        Loop
85	    End If
86	
87	    Dim sumDecimals As Long
88	    If HoursUnitIsMinutes Then sumDecimals = 0 Else sumDecimals = 2
89	
90	    Dim optList As String, v As Variant
91	    For Each v In verifyOptions
92	        optList = optList & v & ","
93	    Next v
94	    If Len(optList) > 0 Then optList = Left(optList, Len(optList) - 1)
95	
96	    If lastRow >= 2 And Len(optList) > 0 Then
97	        LastAction = "FinalizeSheet(" & ws.Name & "): adding Verification dropdown validation"
98	        With ws.Range("Q2:Q" & lastRow).Validation
99	            On Error Resume Next
100	            .Delete
101	            .Add Type:=xlValidateList, AlertStyle:=xlValidAlertStop, Formula1:=optList
102	            On Error GoTo 0
103	        End With
104	    End If
105	
106	    LastAction = "FinalizeSheet(" & ws.Name & "): writing summary header"
107	    ws.Cells(1, 21).Value = "SUMMARY"
108	    ws.Cells(1, 21).Font.Bold = True
109	    Dim sumHrsLbl As String, sumExpLbl As String
110	    If HoursUnitIsMinutes Then
111	        sumHrsLbl = "Minutes Worked": sumExpLbl = "Expected Minutes"
112	    Else
113	        sumHrsLbl = "Hours Worked": sumExpLbl = "Expected Hours"
114	    End If
115	    Dim hdrs As Variant
116	    hdrs = Array("Personnel ID", "Name", "Days Worked", "Late", "Within Grace", "Early Leave", _
117	                 "Missing Punch", "No Punch-Verify", "Roster-Resolved", sumHrsLbl, sumExpLbl)
118	    Dim i As Long
119	    For i = 0 To UBound(hdrs)
120	        With ws.Cells(2, 21 + i)
121	            .Value = hdrs(i)
122	            .Font.Bold = True
123	            .Interior.Color = RGB(230, 241, 251)
124	        End With
125	    Next i
126	
127	    For wi = 1 To weekCount
128	        wCol = 31 + wi
129	        weekHdr = "Wk " & wi & " (" & Format(weekStarts(wi), "dd-mmm") & " to " & Format(weekEnds(wi), "dd-mmm") & ")"
130	        If weekStarts(wi) < firstDate Or weekEnds(wi) > lastDate Then
131	            weekHdr = weekHdr & " (partial)"
132	        End If
133	        With ws.Cells(2, wCol)
134	            .Value = weekHdr
135	            .Font.Bold = True
136	            .Interior.Color = RGB(230, 241, 251)
137	        End With
138	    Next wi
139	
140	    If lastRow >= 2 Then
141	        Dim r As Long
142	        r = 3
143	        Dim itm As Variant, parts() As String, empID As String, empName As String
144	        For Each itm In uniqueEmp
145	            LastAction = "FinalizeSheet(" & ws.Name & "): summary row for employee entry '" & itm & "'"
146	            parts = Split(itm, "|")
147	            empID = parts(0)
148	            empName = parts(1)
149	
150	            ws.Cells(r, 21).Value = empID
151	            ws.Cells(r, 22).Value = empName
152	            ' Days Worked = real punches, plus any NO PUNCH* row whose Verification tag is
153	            ' flagged "Counts as Worked = Y" in tblVerification (workedOptions).
154	            Dim daysWorkedFormula As String, wv As Variant
155	            daysWorkedFormula = "=COUNTIFS($A$2:$A$" & lastRow & ",$U" & r & ",$K$2:$K$" & lastRow & ",""<>"",$K$2:$K$" & lastRow & ",""<>NOT SCHEDULED"",$K$2:$K$" & lastRow & ",""<>NO PUNCH*"")"
156	            For Each wv In workedOptions
157	                daysWorkedFormula = daysWorkedFormula & "+COUNTIFS($A$2:$A$" & lastRow & ",$U" & r & ",$K$2:$K$" & lastRow & ",""NO PUNCH*"",$Q$2:$Q$" & lastRow & ",""" & wv & """)"
158	            Next wv
159	            ws.Cells(r, 23).Formula = daysWorkedFormula
160	            ws.Cells(r, 24).Formula = "=COUNTIFS($A$2:$A$" & lastRow & ",$U" & r & ",$K$2:$K$" & lastRow & ",""Late"")"
161	            ws.Cells(r, 25).Formula = "=COUNTIFS($A$2:$A$" & lastRow & ",$U" & r & ",$K$2:$K$" & lastRow & ",""Within Grace"")+COUNTIFS($A$2:$A$" & lastRow & ",$U" & r & ",$L$2:$L$" & lastRow & ",""Within Grace"")"
162	            ws.Cells(r, 26).Formula = "=COUNTIFS($A$2:$A$" & lastRow & ",$U" & r & ",$L$2:$L$" & lastRow & ",""Early Leave"")"
163	            ws.Cells(r, 27).Formula = "=COUNTIFS($A$2:$A$" & lastRow & ",$U" & r & ",$K$2:$K$" & lastRow & ",""Missing Clock-In"")+COUNTIFS($A$2:$A$" & lastRow & ",$U" & r & ",$L$2:$L$" & lastRow & ",""Missing Clock-Out"")"
164	            ws.Cells(r, 28).Formula = "=COUNTIFS($A$2:$A$" & lastRow & ",$U" & r & ",$K$2:$K$" & lastRow & ",""NO PUNCH - VERIFY"")"
165	            ' Wildcard match: roster-resolved statuses carry a variable code suffix ("NO PUNCH - ROSTER: AL")
166	            ws.Cells(r, 29).Formula = "=COUNTIFS($A$2:$A$" & lastRow & ",$U" & r & ",$K$2:$K$" & lastRow & ",""NO PUNCH - ROSTER: *"")"
167	            ws.Cells(r, 30).Formula = "=ROUND(SUMIFS($O$2:$O$" & lastRow & ",$A$2:$A$" & lastRow & ",$U" & r & ")," & sumDecimals & ")"
168	            ws.Cells(r, 31).Formula = "=ROUND(SUMIFS($P$2:$P$" & lastRow & ",$A$2:$A$" & lastRow & ",$U" & r & ")," & sumDecimals & ")"
169	
170	            For wi = 1 To weekCount
171	                wCol = 31 + wi
172	                ws.Cells(r, wCol).Formula = "=ROUND(SUMIFS($O$2:$O$" & lastRow & ",$A$2:$A$" & lastRow & ",$U" & r & _
173	                    ",$D$2:$D$" & lastRow & ","">=""&DATE(" & Year(weekStarts(wi)) & "," & Month(weekStarts(wi)) & "," & Day(weekStarts(wi)) & _
174	                    "),$D$2:$D$" & lastRow & ",""<=""&DATE(" & Year(weekEnds(wi)) & "," & Month(weekEnds(wi)) & "," & Day(weekEnds(wi)) & "))," & sumDecimals & ")"
175	            Next wi
176	
177	            r = r + 1
178	        Next itm
179	    End If
180	
181	    LastAction = "FinalizeSheet(" & ws.Name & "): autofitting columns"
182	    ' AutoFit measures rendered text width, so it computes wrong (too-narrow) widths
183	    ' while ScreenUpdating is off -- the caller runs this whole pipeline with it False.
184	    Dim priorScreenUpdating As Boolean
185	    priorScreenUpdating = Application.ScreenUpdating
186	    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
187	    Dim lastCol As Long
188	    lastCol = ws.Cells(2, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
189	    ws.Range(ws.Columns(1), ws.Columns(lastCol)).AutoFit
190	    Application.ScreenUpdating = priorScreenUpdating
191	
192	    LastAction = "FinalizeSheet(" & ws.Name & "): setting freeze panes"
193	    ws.Application.Goto ws.Range("A1"), True
194	    ActiveWindow.FreezePanes = False
195	    ws.Rows("2:2").Select
196	    ActiveWindow.FreezePanes = True
197	    ws.Range("A1").Select
198	End Sub

200	Public Sub BuildDepartmentSheets(srcWs As Worksheet, outWb As Workbook, schedule As Object, _
201	                                  verifyOptions As Collection, workedOptions As Collection, noExpectedOptions As Collection, _
202	                                  dayCols() As Long, dayDates() As Date, dayNames() As String, _
203	                                  rosterCodes As Object, rosterData As Object)
204	    Dim lastRow As Long, r As Long
205	    lastRow = srcWs.Cells(srcWs.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
206	
207	    Dim deptSheetMap As Object, deptRowMap As Object, deptEmpMap As Object, deptBandMap As Object
208	    Set deptSheetMap = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
209	    Set deptRowMap = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
210	    Set deptEmpMap = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
211	    Set deptBandMap = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
212	    Set DataWarnings = New Collection
213	
214	    Dim unmappedWs As Worksheet, unmappedRow As Long, unmappedEmp As Collection
215	    Dim unmappedBand As Boolean
216	    Set unmappedEmp = New Collection
217	    unmappedRow = 2
218	
219	    For r = 4 To lastRow
220	        Dim empID As String, fName As String, dept As String
221	        empID = Trim(CStr(srcWs.Cells(r, 1).Value))
222	        If empID = "" Then GoTo NextRow
223	
224	        fName = Trim(Trim(CStr(srcWs.Cells(r, 2).Value)) & " " & Trim(CStr(srcWs.Cells(r, 3).Value)))
225	        dept = Trim(CStr(srcWs.Cells(r, 4).Value))
226	        If dept = "" Then GoTo NextRow
227	
228	        Dim mapped As Boolean
229	        mapped = DeptHasScheduleRows(schedule, dept)
230	
231	        Dim ws As Worksheet, outRow As Long, empColl As Collection
232	
233	        If mapped Then
234	            If Not deptSheetMap.Exists(dept) Then
235	                LastAction = "BuildDepartmentSheets: creating sheet for dept '" & dept & "'"
236	                Set ws = outWb.Sheets.Add(After:=outWb.Sheets(outWb.Sheets.Count))
237	                ws.Name = Left(dept, 31)
238	                WriteDetailHeader ws
239	                Set deptSheetMap(dept) = ws
240	                deptRowMap(dept) = 2
241	                Set deptEmpMap(dept) = New Collection
242	            End If
243	            Set ws = deptSheetMap(dept)
244	            outRow = deptRowMap(dept)
245	            Set empColl = deptEmpMap(dept)
246	            deptBandMap(dept) = Not deptBandMap(dept)
247	        Else
248	            If unmappedWs Is Nothing Then
249	                Set unmappedWs = outWb.Sheets.Add(After:=outWb.Sheets(outWb.Sheets.Count))
250	                unmappedWs.Name = "Unmapped"
251	                WriteDetailHeader unmappedWs
252	            End If
253	            Set ws = unmappedWs
254	            outRow = unmappedRow
255	            Set empColl = unmappedEmp
256	            unmappedBand = Not unmappedBand
257	        End If
258	
259	        Dim isAltBand As Boolean
260	        If mapped Then isAltBand = deptBandMap(dept) Else isAltBand = unmappedBand
261	
262	        Dim blockStartRow As Long
263	        blockStartRow = outRow
264	
265	        On Error Resume Next
266	        empColl.Add empID & "|" & fName, empID
267	        On Error GoTo 0
268	
269	        Dim d As Long
270	        For d = LBound(dayCols) To UBound(dayCols)
271	            LastAction = "BuildDepartmentSheets: row " & r & " (empID=" & empID & ", dept=" & dept & "), day " & dayNames(d)
272	            Dim rawVal As String
273	            rawVal = CStr(srcWs.Cells(r, dayCols(d)).Value)
274	
275	            Dim patType As String, hasIn As Boolean, hasOut As Boolean, inTime As Double, outT As Double
276	            patType = ParsePunchCell(rawVal, hasIn, hasOut, inTime, outT)
277	
278	            Dim key As String
279	            key = BuildScheduleKey(dept, dayNames(d))
280	            Dim isSched As Boolean, schedStart As Double, schedEnd As Double
281	            isSched = False
282	            If schedule.Exists(key) Then
283	                isSched = schedule(key)(0)
284	                schedStart = schedule(key)(1)
285	                schedEnd = schedule(key)(2)
286	            End If
287	
288	            Dim statusIn As String, statusOut As String
289	            Dim lateMin As Variant, earlyMin As Variant, hrsWorked As Variant, expHrs As Variant, verifyMatch As Variant
290	            Dim effectiveIn As Double
291	            Dim isNoPunchRow As Boolean, orTerms As String, ov As Variant
292	            statusIn = "": statusOut = ""
293	            lateMin = Empty: earlyMin = Empty: hrsWorked = Empty: expHrs = Empty: verifyMatch = Empty
294	
295	            Select Case patType
296	                Case "NOPUNCH", "BLANK"
297	                    If Not isSched Then
298	                        ' Nobody was due in, so there is nothing to chase and nothing to
299	                        ' resolve -- skip the roster lookup so Verification stays blank.
300	                        statusIn = "NOT SCHEDULED"
301	                        statusOut = "N/A"
302	                    Else
303	                        statusIn = "NO PUNCH - VERIFY"
304	                        statusOut = "N/A"
305	                        Dim rKey As String, rCode As String
306	                        rKey = UCase(Trim(fName)) & "|" & Day(dayDates(d))
307	                        If rosterData.Exists(rKey) Then
308	                            rCode = CStr(rosterData(rKey))
309	                            If rosterCodes.Exists(rCode) Then
310	                                verifyMatch = rCode
311	                                statusIn = "NO PUNCH - ROSTER: " & rCode
312	                            End If
313	                        End If
314	                    End If
315	                Case "MISSING_OUT"
316	                    statusOut = "Missing Clock-Out"
317	                    If isSched Then
318	                        statusIn = ClassifyInStatus(inTime, schedStart, GracePeriodMinutes)
319	                        lateMin = (inTime - schedStart) * 1440
320	                        If lateMin < 0 Then lateMin = 0
321	                        lateMin = Round(lateMin, 1)
322	                    Else
323	                        statusIn = "On Time"
324	                    End If
325	                Case "MISSING_IN"
326	                    statusIn = "Missing Clock-In"
327	                    If isSched Then
328	                        statusOut = ClassifyOutStatus(outT, schedEnd, GracePeriodMinutes)
329	                        earlyMin = (schedEnd - outT) * 1440
330	                        If earlyMin < 0 Then earlyMin = 0
331	                        earlyMin = Round(earlyMin, 1)
332	                    Else
333	                        statusOut = "On Time"
334	                    End If
335	                Case "NORMAL"
336	                    If outT < inTime Then
337	                        ' Midnight-crossing punch (e.g. 20:00-08:00): both times are built
338	                        ' within a single day by ParsePunchCell, so the span goes negative.
339	                        ' Overnight shifts are out of scope -- fail loudly instead of writing
340	                        ' a negative hours value that SUMIFS would silently total up.
341	                        statusIn = "OVERNIGHT - VERIFY"
342	                        statusOut = "OVERNIGHT - VERIFY"
343	                    ElseIf isSched Then
344	                        statusIn = ClassifyInStatus(inTime, schedStart, GracePeriodMinutes)
345	                        statusOut = ClassifyOutStatus(outT, schedEnd, GracePeriodMinutes)
346	                        lateMin = (inTime - schedStart) * 1440
347	                        If lateMin < 0 Then lateMin = 0
348	                        lateMin = Round(lateMin, 1)
349	                        earlyMin = (schedEnd - outT) * 1440
350	                        If earlyMin < 0 Then earlyMin = 0
351	                        earlyMin = Round(earlyMin, 1)
352	
353	                        effectiveIn = inTime
354	                        If effectiveIn < schedStart Then effectiveIn = schedStart
355	                        hrsWorked = SpanToHoursUnit(outT - effectiveIn)
356	                    Else
357	                        statusIn = "On Time (Unscheduled Day)"
358	                        statusOut = "On Time (Unscheduled Day)"
359	                        ' raw punch-to-punch span: no schedStart to clamp against
360	                        hrsWorked = SpanToHoursUnit(outT - inTime)
361	                    End If
362	                Case Else
363	                    statusIn = "UNRECOGNIZED FORMAT"
364	                    statusOut = "UNRECOGNIZED FORMAT"
365	            End Select
366	
367	            If isSched Then
368	                expHrs = SpanToHoursUnit(schedEnd - schedStart)
369	            End If
370	
371	            ws.Cells(outRow, 1).Value = empID
372	            ws.Cells(outRow, 2).Value = fName
373	            ws.Cells(outRow, 3).Value = dept
374	            ws.Cells(outRow, 4).Value = dayDates(d)
375	            ws.Cells(outRow, 4).NumberFormat = "dd/mm/yyyy"
376	            ws.Cells(outRow, 5).Value = dayNames(d)
377	            ws.Cells(outRow, 6).Value = rawVal
378	            If hasIn Then
379	                ws.Cells(outRow, 7).Value = inTime
380	                ws.Cells(outRow, 7).NumberFormat = "hh:mm"
381	            End If
382	            If hasOut Then
383	                ws.Cells(outRow, 8).Value = outT
384	                ws.Cells(outRow, 8).NumberFormat = "hh:mm"
385	            End If
386	            If isSched Then
387	                ws.Cells(outRow, 9).Value = schedStart
388	                ws.Cells(outRow, 9).NumberFormat = "hh:mm"
389	                ws.Cells(outRow, 10).Value = schedEnd
390	                ws.Cells(outRow, 10).NumberFormat = "hh:mm"
391	            End If
392	            ws.Cells(outRow, 11).Value = statusIn
393	            ws.Cells(outRow, 12).Value = statusOut
394	            If Not IsEmpty(lateMin) Then ws.Cells(outRow, 13).Value = lateMin
395	            If Not IsEmpty(earlyMin) Then ws.Cells(outRow, 14).Value = earlyMin
396	
397	            isNoPunchRow = (patType = "NOPUNCH" Or patType = "BLANK")
398	            If isSched And isNoPunchRow Then
399	                ' Expected Hours defaults to a full shift and blanks out only when the
400	                ' Verification tag is flagged "Expected Hours = N" -- an untagged purple row
401	                ' is an unexplained absence on a scheduled day, so hours are expected by default.
402	                orTerms = ""
403	                For Each ov In noExpectedOptions
404	                    orTerms = orTerms & "$Q" & outRow & "=""" & ov & ""","
405	                Next ov
406	                If Len(orTerms) > 0 Then orTerms = Left(orTerms, Len(orTerms) - 1)
407	                If Len(orTerms) > 0 Then
408	                    ws.Cells(outRow, 16).Formula = "=IF(OR(" & orTerms & "),""""," & expHrs & ")"
409	                Else
410	                    ws.Cells(outRow, 16).Value = expHrs
411	                End If
412	
413	                ' Hours Worked stays blank unless the tag is flagged "Counts as Worked = Y",
414	                ' in which case it credits exactly one shift by reading the Expected Hours cell.
415	                orTerms = ""
416	                For Each ov In workedOptions
417	                    orTerms = orTerms & "$Q" & outRow & "=""" & ov & ""","
418	                Next ov
419	                If Len(orTerms) > 0 Then orTerms = Left(orTerms, Len(orTerms) - 1)
420	                If Len(orTerms) > 0 Then
421	                    ws.Cells(outRow, 15).Formula = "=IF(OR(" & orTerms & "),$P" & outRow & ","""")"
422	                End If
423	            Else
424	                If Not IsEmpty(hrsWorked) Then ws.Cells(outRow, 15).Value = hrsWorked
425	                If Not IsEmpty(expHrs) Then ws.Cells(outRow, 16).Value = expHrs
426	            End If
427	            If Not IsEmpty(verifyMatch) Then ws.Cells(outRow, 17).Value = verifyMatch
428	
429	            ApplyRowColor ws, outRow, statusIn, isAltBand
430	
431	            outRow = outRow + 1
432	        Next d
433	
434	        If outRow > blockStartRow Then
435	            With ws.Range(ws.Cells(outRow - 1, 1), ws.Cells(outRow - 1, 18)).Borders(xlEdgeBottom)
436	                .LineStyle = xlContinuous
437	                .Weight = xlThick
438	                .Color = RGB(80, 80, 80)
439	            End With
440	        End If
441	
442	        If mapped Then
443	            deptRowMap(dept) = outRow
444	        Else
445	            unmappedRow = outRow
446	        End If
447	NextRow:
448	    Next r
449	
450	    Dim dKey As Variant
451	    For Each dKey In deptSheetMap.Keys
452	        Dim finalWs As Worksheet, finalEmp As Collection, deptLastRow As Long
453	        Set finalWs = deptSheetMap(dKey)
454	        Set finalEmp = deptEmpMap(dKey)
455	
456	        deptLastRow = deptRowMap(dKey) - 1
457	        If deptLastRow >= 2 Then
458	            If Application.WorksheetFunction.CountA(finalWs.Range(finalWs.Cells(2, 7), finalWs.Cells(deptLastRow, 8))) = 0 Then
459	                DataWarnings.Add CStr(dKey) & ": no punch data found for any employee -- check the export covers this department."
460	            End If
461	        End If
462	
463	        FinalizeSheet finalWs, verifyOptions, workedOptions, finalEmp
464	    Next dKey
465	    If Not unmappedWs Is Nothing Then
466	        FinalizeSheet unmappedWs, verifyOptions, workedOptions, unmappedEmp
467	    End If

65	' Normalises a header string for tolerant comparison:
66	'   - converts line breaks (Chr 10 / 13) and non-breaking spaces (Chr 160) to spaces
67	'   - collapses any run of spaces to a single space
68	'   - trims ends and upper-cases
69	Public Function NormHeader(s As String) As String
70	    Dim t As String
71	    t = CStr(s)
72	    t = Replace(t, Chr(10), " ")
73	    t = Replace(t, Chr(13), " ")
74	    t = Replace(t, Chr(160), " ")
75	    t = Replace(t, vbTab, " ")
76	    Do While InStr(t, "  ") > 0
77	        t = Replace(t, "  ", " ")
78	    Loop
79	    NormHeader = UCase(Trim(t))
80	End Function
